title: UnClove's Garbage Bin
description: a mishmash of mod ideas in a neat package made with MCreator
body:
BEHOLD A MISHMASH OF MODS!

right now only one section of it is available but don't worry there's more to come
let me list all the planned sections
![the deepshade section](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/400703445bc99c44a7b6ef734a3244950070904d.png)
state:released

it adds 4 new mobs: 

the currupted mace

2 berry creatures

and the rippling

a new dimension: the further down with it's own biomes. the DEEPSHADE and the WASTEDSHADE.

a woodtype (no sapling because it's tree population are fixed)

new ore

and a new sword

![bloomin springs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83b5dd7c56d86bf4657c17f95c78d3136988be26.png)
status: under development

this section will add 2 new biome.the spring fields . with vibrant bright green grass with petals and flowers as far as the eye can see. and the autumn falls with orange leaves and grass. piles and piles of leaves 

new mobs. currently only the springlings with 4 varients (with seperate spawn eggs). and more 
mobs planned

a new ore.
new flowers and a scrapped official minecraft flower readded

the section has a preview in the current version so you can see the springlings
![sweet treats](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e72e0e864fa273109496c2af1cc00cca52693834.png)
status:planned

this section is planned to add 2 new overworld biomes (names undecided) 4 new mobs. new items
and an armor type
![crystal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/45db59958009a804a139b7166b5df3ad9a3cb9e3.png)
status:planned

this section is planned to add an underground biome with 2 mobs. new ore. and a new material 
type for building: crystals. will probably add rubies

___________________________________________________________________________________________
currently known bugs: mobs spawning in the further down biome due to spawning idle causes them to despawn
despawning for the further down mobs will be turned off until i can figure out a solution
___________________________________________________________________________________________
expansion pack mods will come after each section
